title: Valid Parentheses
description: Push openers; on a closer, the top of the stack must match. Empty stack at the end = valid.

notes: `stack.pop()` on an empty array returns undefined — which mismatches every opener, so the early return still works.
The final `stack.length === 0` check catches unclosed openers at the end of input.
Map closer → opener so the lookup at the closer is O(1).

questions.q: Why must the final stack be empty for validity?
options: Anything left on the stack is an unclosed opener

questions.q: If `stack.pop()` runs on an empty stack:
options: Returns undefined → mismatches every opener → false

questions.q: What data structure does this use?
Why map closer → opener and not opener → closer?
options: When we see a closer, we want to know what opener it should match
Closer keys are easier to spell

L3.prompt: Write `isValid(s)` returning true iff brackets `()[]{}` are balanced and properly nested. Log `isValid("()[]{}")`.
hints: On every closer, pop and verify the pair.
